interface.shortDescription: 95 local-first MCP tools, 21 skills & 19 agents for Chilean Civil Law.
interface.longDescription: Open Legal Chile is an open-source, local-first legal intelligence plugin for Chilean Civil Law. It bundles 95 MCP tools across 10 official Chilean state connectors (BCN Ley Chile, PJUD Supreme & Constitutional Courts, CGR, DT, SII, CMF, SMA, TDLC, CNE, and Panel de Expertos), a hybrid doctrinal corpus & LegalGraphify knowledge graph, 21 specialized legal skills, and 19 domain subagents. Runs locally via uvx with zero client-data leakage and strict statutory citation verification.
